i.h: Rep. Rob Menendez wins reelection to third term

i.x: Today, I’m especially thankful for the place that raised me—Union City! Forever grateful for this community & honored to fight for it every day in Congress. 💙

Texas made history tonight by electing Gina Hinojosa as its FIRST Latina governor! 👏💪 Across the country, Latino voters showed up to fight for working families and a better future. A historic victory for Texas and a proud moment for our Latino community and the nation!
Smells like fresh pastelitos and a House majority within reach.. Fueled the home stretch with a cafe con leche at El Artesano! ☕️
